title: FINALLY!!! Apple App Store and Google Play Approved My Game!
author: WeDevelopGames
selftext:
Please support my game, INCREDIBLE SPACEMAN

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wedevelopgames.spaceman

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/incredible-spaceman/id6799765948

comments.author: thegreatredbeard
comments.body: The game looks cool. The in-app gameplay seems higher fidelity than the screenshots you’ve put on the App Store listing. Not sure if you’re just taking iOS sim screenshots which don’t always give full quality etc, maybe have a look into it.

replies.author: WeDevelopGames
replies.body: First of all, thank you for your thoughtful response. The android version does not have the in app purchase feature available due to some technical reasons but the coin shop remains intact and you can unlock the collected outfits using the collected coins. Secondly, the gravity is purposely added to make the game more fun. I added a feature where there was literally no gravity in the game and the game was way easier and boring at the same time. Since it’s a game so a complete logical explanation makes no sense but also takes the fun out of it. Once you keep playing this game you will realise that it’s actually really fun! Hope you like it!
